messages.content:
Decompose this claim into ALL atomic numerical outcome relationships, without checking whether they are true. Return JSON with keys complete (boolean) and records (array). Each record must describe one group, endpoint, point value and its conditions. Resolve cross-sentence references from this claim only. Copy the group, endpoint, time frame, analysis population, category and denominator strings exactly as stated, removing only quotation delimiters. Do not omit a numeric relationship. Do not invent missing conditions: use empty string. A denominator such as Participants: 15 is NOT an analysis population. If no population description is stated, population MUST be empty. Do not copy a denominator into population. Preserve conditions shared by multiple records. A comparison, negation, approximate value or derived arithmetic that cannot be expressed as exact point records must set complete=false, never silently drop it.
Every record has string fields: group, endpoint, value (decimal only), unit, statistic, time, population, denominator, category; and quotes: an array of exact verbatim substrings from the claim supporting this decomposition. Statistic is mean, median, or count if stated. Return only JSON.
CLAIM:
The table gives 5.99 hour (hr) as the MEDIAN for Time of Observed Maximum Plasma Concentration (Tmax) of PF-06952229 (Part 1A) in Part 1A: PF-06952229 150mg Monotherapy (time frame: 0 (pre dose), 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6 and 12 hours (post dose) on Day 1 and 7 of cycle 1, 0 (pre dose), 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6 and 12 hours (post dose) on Day 1 of cycle 2.; denominator: Participants: 4; population: Participants with advanced/metastatic tumors in PF-06952229 single agent dose escalation phase, who had sufficient information to estimate at least 1 of the PK parameters of interest. Here, "number analyzed" signifies participant evaluable for each row.; category: Cycle 1 Day 7).
